lead: I design digital products that make complex systems feel clear, purposeful, and easy to use.
paragraphs: With more than 3 years of experience across UI/UX design, product development, and implementation support, I turn user needs and business goals into intuitive digital experiences.

My work spans health intelligence, insurance platforms, enterprise dashboards, and AI-powered products—collaborating closely with developers, QA teams, and stakeholders from early exploration through UAT.
